advisories.reachability: request performs HTTP(S) requests, and with --internal hyperlink loads only local files, so no request is made; The only dependency path is hyperlink, which docs:build runs as `hyperlink --root <staged output> --internal <emitted html files>` (scripts/docs.cjs checkerArgs); no URL is ever passed.
advisories.remediation: No patched release exists (request is deprecated). Leave when hyperlink drops request/assetgraph; no major or unverified override is forced.

advisories.reachability: The cookie jar is used only by request while it performs an HTTP request, which --internal never starts; The only dependency path is hyperlink, which docs:build runs as `hyperlink --root <staged output> --internal <emitted html files>` (scripts/docs.cjs checkerArgs); no URL is ever passed.
advisories.remediation: A patched tough-cookie (>=4.1.3) is a different major line than request 2.88.2 accepts (~2.3); revisit when hyperlink replaces request.

advisories.reachability: The advisory concerns esbuild's development server (`serve`). VitePress runs only `vitepress build docs`, which uses esbuild's transform/build API; no development server is started and the `dev`, `serve` and `preview` commands are not exposed by any script.
advisories.remediation: Needs vite >=6.4 through a VitePress release that supports it; a forced major override is not applied without verification.

advisories.reachability: html-minifier runs only inside assetgraph's Html#minify, which hyperlink never calls; it reads and inspects documents without minifying them. The only dependency path is hyperlink, which docs:build runs as `hyperlink --root <staged output> --internal <emitted html files>` (scripts/docs.cjs checkerArgs); no URL is ever passed.
advisories.remediation: No patched release exists. Leave when hyperlink drops assetgraph.

advisories.reachability: Optimized-dependency `.map` handling is served by the Vite development server only. docs:build runs the production build and starts no server.
advisories.remediation: Needs vite >=6.4.2 through a VitePress release that supports it; no unverified major override is applied.

advisories.reachability: The launch-editor middleware that opens files from the browser exists in the Vite development server on Windows; docs:build starts no development server.
advisories.remediation: Needs vite >=6.4.3 through a VitePress release that supports it; no unverified major override is applied.

advisories.reachability: `server.fs.deny` is enforced by the Vite development server; docs:build starts no development server and serves no files.
advisories.remediation: Needs vite >=6.4.3 through a VitePress release that supports it; no unverified major override is applied.

advisories.reachability: The flaw requires an AbortSignal: aborting can leave the returned promise pending. The installed http-proxy-agent calls once(socket, connect) without an AbortSignal, so it does not reach that branch. Vitest jsdom loads no remote resources and hyperlink --internal opens no connection.
advisories.remediation: Patched @tootallnate/once is a new major line for http-proxy-agent 4/5; revisit with the next jsdom and hyperlink upgrades.

advisories.reachability: The missing bounds check applies to uuid v3/v5/v6 called with a caller-supplied buffer; request calls only uuid/v4 without one, and --internal makes no request at all.
advisories.remediation: Patched uuid is a different major line than request accepts; revisit when hyperlink replaces request.

advisories.reachability: cssnano runs only inside assetgraph's Css#minify, which hyperlink never calls, so no stylesheet selector is parsed by it; The only dependency path is hyperlink, which docs:build runs as `hyperlink --root <staged output> --internal <emitted html files>` (scripts/docs.cjs checkerArgs); no URL is ever passed.
advisories.remediation: Patched postcss-selector-parser 7 is a different major line than cssnano 5 accepts; revisit when hyperlink upgrades assetgraph.

advisories.reachability: @next/eslint-plugin-next expands globs with fast-glob only for the `next.rootDir` setting, and neither the generator's nor the application's ESLint configuration sets it, so no brace pattern from input reaches braces. tests/contracts/audit-policy.test.ts fails if a rootDir setting appears.
advisories.remediation: No patched release exists. Leave when fast-glob/micromatch publish one; do not set next.rootDir meanwhile.
